pr_body:
This commit changes the default indices options of the new terms enum API
to be consistent with _search.
This change also fixes the shards statistics in the response when ccs is involved.

Closes #75155

issue_context.title: New TermsEnum returns 404 on non-existent subtraction indexes e.g. (logs-*,-elastic-cloud-logs-*) instead of 200

review_comments: Safe to assume terms_enum options will always be aligned with that of search?
That's the intent of the PR, yes.
